name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer focused on its flagship Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company completed a Pre-Feasibility Study in 2024 outlining a large-scale open-pit operation. It is in the advanced exploration and development stage, with the Diablillos project formally approved under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI).
